blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Anti-narcotics operatives confiscated four kilograms of suspected shabu valued at P27.2 million and arrested three individuals in a joint buy-bust operation in Barangay Bulacao late Friday night, October 9, 2026. The operation, carried out around 9:45 p.m. at Saint Jude Phase 2, was jointly executed by operatives of the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in Central Visayas (PDEA-7) and the Cebu City Police Office (CCPO) Station 7. PDEA-7 Director Joel Plaza identified the main subject of the sting as alias “Joseph,” a 33-year-old food vendor residing in Barangay Mohon, Talisay City.
